1. Indian QSRs: Growth vs Profit
India’s QSR industry is showing early signs of recovery, but simply opening more stores is no longer enough. Domino’s, KFC, Pizza Hut and McDonald’s are taking different approaches to improve sales and profitability at existing outlets in Q1 FY27.
